description: This file defines the main React component for a travel itinerary planner web page. It manages state for days and activities, fetches data from API services, and renders UI elements including modals for adding/editing days and activities. It also handles user interactions like adding, editing, and deleting itinerary days and activities.

methods.name: handleAddDay
methods.description: Adds a new itinerary day, either via API call or demo fallback, and updates the days state.

methods.name: handleDeleteDay
methods.description: Deletes an itinerary day after user confirmation, updating state and calling API or fallback.

methods.name: handleAddActivity
methods.description: Adds a new activity to a specific day, updating state and API or fallback.

methods.name: handleUpdateActivity
methods.description: Updates an existing activity's details via API or fallback, updating the day's activities in state.

methods.name: handleDeleteActivity
methods.description: Removes an activity from a day, updating state and API or fallback.
